_comment: Trans Pride collection: Pokémon wearing the transgender pride flag. Each name in 'lines' brings in its WHOLE evolutionary line. The 18 lines were picked with `generate.py pick --count 18 --seed trans-pride-2026` (random lines no other collection uses).

readme.title: Trans Pride
readme.summary: Pokemon wearing the transgender pride flag.
looks: the flag's five stripes (light blue, pink, white, pink, light blue) run across the whole body, head to toe, lined up across every part of the model
each stripe keeps the Pokemon's own shading, markings and outlines, and the eyes keep their colours
glowing parts glow in the flag's colours
shiny: pastel glitter, plus sparkles that twinkle and glow in the dark
